text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the New Year, when I visited a 
bookstore to buy a training guidebook……

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year. Buying textbooks right at 
the start of the year—your dedication is 
truly impressive.
choice_data_list:
Happy New Year! Are you looking for books 
too, Casino?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes, looking for travel magazines. They 
should all be right over there.
choice_data_list: Is there somewhere you want to go?
Is there anywhere you'd like to go?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no. What I want is the actual magazine 
photo itself.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Have you heard of a "Dream Board"? It's a 
practice that developed in America, but――

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
It's where you gather photos that 
represent your goals and arrange them on a 
corkboard or similar display.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Expressing your goals in a visible form... 
gives you a much clearer vision of 
achieving them.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, then why don't you join me? Even 
just gazing at the covers of magazines is 
quite delightful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of us ended up browsing 
the magazine aisle.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"100 Spectacular Sights of the World: Top 
Tourist Attractions"... Good. I'd love to 
go traveling around the world someday.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's leading a massive project to conquer 
the Breeders' Cup. No doubt she has plenty 
of goals in mind.
choice_data_list:
That corkboard is going to fill up in no 
time.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Heheh. Actually, instead of a 
corkboard――

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I make a point of sticking them inside my 
notebook's back cover. It's been a habit 
of mine since I was little.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I want to seize my dream with my own two 
hands. ...Because that has always been my 
wish.

text_block_list.name: Young Casino
text_block_list.text:
"Hup... hehe, cut it nice and clean. The 
race from that day, and photos of the 
senpai I look up to..."

text_block_list.name: Casino's Older Sister A
text_block_list.text:
"Casino, dinner's ready――oh? Magazine 
clippings... Ah, a dream board, is it!"

text_block_list.name: Casino's Older Sister B
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't that wonderful! Hey, hey, what kind 
of dream is it? Big Sis will help make her 
cute little sister's dream come true!"

text_block_list.name: Young Casino
text_block_list.text: "Ah――N-No, you can't!"

text_block_list.name: Young Casino
text_block_list.text:
"Ah... I-I'm sorry! Um, Big Sisters... you 
see,"

text_block_list.name: Young Casino
text_block_list.text:
"This is something... I want to achieve 
with my own two hands. That's why I don't 
want to show it to anyone."

text_block_list.name: Casino's Older Sister A
text_block_list.text: "――! Oh... is that so? ...Hey, Casino――"

text_block_list.name: Casino's Older Sister A
text_block_list.text:
"Give it your all and make it come true. 
Every single one of us is cheering for 
your dream."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
There is a saying that sharing your goals 
with others makes them easier to achieve. 
However—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
To look upon what you admire with your own 
eyes and draw closer to your dream. That 
is my belief.
choice_data_list:
(She's stuck to her principles ever since 
she was little, huh...)

(She's really stuck to her principles ever 
since she was little...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chasing a dream entirely on your own. It 
sounds easy enough in words, but putting 
it into practice is another story.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because whenever you hit a wall, you're 
the only one who can pick yourself back 
up.
choice_data_list:
Maybe I should try making a dream board 
too.

Maybe I should try making a dream board 
too.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Oho—That's the spirit. This is a splendid 
chance to re-evaluate your goals.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Do you have a corkboard ready? Depending 
on its size, the number of photos we can 
display will change.
choice_data_list: No…… I'll go with the planner!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: —Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Single-mindedly chasing her dream for 
years on end... Casino Drive came to Japan 
to take on the world, launching her very 
own project.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one who made that come true was 
surely—
choice_data_list: Because I was inspired by your strength.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: My own――

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: ...You really are something else...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: —No. I am honored to hear you say that.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Well then... to express my gratitude for 
those kind words, allow me to offer a 
suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
This general store has a huge variety of 
planners, doesn't it? Ever since coming to 
Japan, I've chosen my planner here every 
year.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
The cover design of a planner is important 
too. After all, you'll be looking at it 
constantly.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
In my case, I chose a chic design to help 
me stay focused and composed, but――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, I continued consulting 
with her as we purchased a notebook for 
her Dream Board.
